The PDF p.4 footnote links https://github.com/YaoFANGUK/video-subtitle-remover for subtitle removal; gh verified it as a separate utility repository at main commit e109b9ddc1d0e8f153199dfa05c1d767546906d8, with no paper visual sources. paper_style.palette_strategy: 正文结果使用少量高饱和 categorical bar colors；流程图、taxonomy cards、qualitative atlas 和 prompt panels 使用蓝/橙/绿/灰的浅色填充区分模块或类别。颜色常与位置、标题、marker 或文字结构配合，但 qualitative/pastel objects 的灰度冗余有限。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: PDF 正文文本、表格规则和结果条形图主要是可提取的 PDF text/path；Figure 1–4、6–8 和附录 qualitative panels 混合矢量文字/图形与嵌入视频帧 JPEG；Figures 9–17 为以圆角面板承载的 prompt/annotation 版式，文字和背景在 PDF 中呈 mixed 资源。全部 34 页已以 180 dpi 渲染检查。
paper_style.style_consistency: 正文和 captions 以 Nimbus Roman No9 L/Computer Modern 为主，嵌入图形和 prompt/qualitative card 使用 Times New Roman、Arial、NimbusMonL；表格稳定采用 booktabs、无竖线、单/双栏切换。全篇圆角浅色卡片、filmstrip 边框、直接标签和方法/结果的短 caption 形成统一视觉语言，但 appendix prompt 与 qualitative atlas 的文字密度明显高于正文结果图。

figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. Metaphorical videos are prevalent across various real-world scenarios to convey many complex ideas, and metaphorical video understanding requires high-order cognitive capabilities.

color.semantic_mapping: Video/platform thumbnails establish the source; pale gray cards encode recognition and event description; orange accents mark the metaphor-understanding focus; blue/peach cards separate visual elements, underlying concepts, and implicit meanings.

encodings.x: left-to-right conceptual stages from video to meaning
encodings.y: stacked semantic levels and card lanes
encodings.color: platform/source, literal recognition, event description, and metaphor mapping roles
encodings.shape: video thumbnails, rounded cards, icons, and directional arrows
encodings.text: Recognition, Event Description, Visual Elements, Underlying Concepts, Implicit Meanings, and example phrases

figures.data_and_statistics: Conceptual illustration only. It contains thumbnail examples and an element→concept→meaning mapping, but no sample denominator, uncertainty, or quantitative estimate.
figures.evidence_relation: The introduction frames metaphor understanding as a transformation from perceptual signals to deeper semantics; the figure makes that cross-domain mapping visible before the benchmark and method sections.
design_strengths: The three semantic levels are aligned in one reading path.
Direct labels and arrows remove the need for a separate legend.
The small video strip and platform column anchor the claim in real-world short-video inputs.
design_weaknesses: The right-column width makes several labels and thumbnails small at 180 dpi.
Pastel colors carry role distinctions but are not fully robust in grayscale.
The conceptual examples are illustrative rather than evidence of prevalence or performance.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a compact element→concept→meaning pipeline as the opening visual anchor, then reserve quantitative objects for prevalence and capability claims.

figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2. MetaphorVU-Bench contains 8 types of video metaphor, enabling systematic evaluation of metaphorical video understanding. Note that most videos simultaneously contain multiple types of metaphor, we only show the dominant one in each case for illustration.

color.semantic_mapping: Eight pastel card headers/backgrounds distinguish Body Language, Atmosphere Language, Cultural Symbol, Naturalistic Symbol, Causal Montage, Analogical Montage, Surreal Narrative, and Performative Narrative.

encodings.y: filmstrip above interpretation text within each card
encodings.color: taxonomy type via pastel header and card background
encodings.shape: six-frame filmstrips and rounded qualitative cards
encodings.line: filmstrip borders and dotted outer frame
encodings.text: type labels, titles, and bullet interpretations

figures.data_and_statistics: Qualitative taxonomy display: eight dominant metaphor types, one example card per type, and no statistical aggregation or uncertainty encoding.
figures.evidence_relation: The taxonomy in §2.1 is instantiated with one dominant example per type; the figure supplies the visual vocabulary used by Table 1 and the later category-wise evaluation.
design_strengths: Eight classes are visible at a glance in a stable 2×4 grid.
Each filmstrip is paired with an interpretation, preserving the task’s visual-to-semantic relation.
The repeated card grammar supports comparison without a legend.
design_weaknesses: The grid is text dense and its bullet text is small at page scale.
The category palette is decorative more than redundant; similar pastel values can merge in grayscale.
One example cannot represent within-type diversity, which the caption acknowledges only briefly.
figures.reusable_pattern: Define a taxonomy with repeated filmstrip-plus-interpretation cards so readers can map category names to concrete visual semantics before reading scores.

figures.label: Figure 3

caption.text: Figure 3. We construct MetaphorVU-Bench by using a real-world short-video platform as source, selecting metaphorical videos from a large-scale video pool through multi-stage filtration, and manually annotating video metaphor interpretations with rigorous quality control. MetaphorVU-Bench can effectively support systematic and comprehensive evaluation of metaphorical video understanding.

color.semantic_mapping: Gray represents the real-world source, blue the multi-stage filtration block, peach manual annotation, and colored icons distinguish comments/LLM/MLLM/human roles.

encodings.y: one pipeline lane with internal vertical stages
encodings.color: stage ownership and filtering modality
encodings.shape: rounded stage boxes, icons, and arrows
encodings.text: billions, ~70K, ~16K, ~4K, 860 data, and eight types

figures.data_and_statistics: The funnel labels approximate intermediate pool sizes (billions, ~70K, ~16K, ~4K) and the final 860 videos across eight types; no uncertainty or repeated-run variation is shown.
figures.evidence_relation: The construction section claims a comment/LLM/MLLM/human sequence with strict quality control; the visual provides the process evidence behind the benchmark’s provenance and filtering boundaries.
design_strengths: The three ownership stages and numeric attrition points are easy to follow.
Icons and labels redundantly identify comment, LLM, MLLM, and human filtering.
Page-width placement gives enough room for process labels and arrows.
design_weaknesses: Intermediate counts use approximate tildes and are not tied to a denominator definition.
The diagram does not expose exclusion rates or reviewer agreement.
Icon colors are not a formal encoding key and may be ambiguous when isolated.
figures.reusable_pattern: Show data provenance as a small number of owned stages with explicit attrition counts and a final annotation contract.

figures.label: Figure 4

caption.text: Figure 4. Benchmark covers diverse video topics, enabling accurate evaluation of real-world metaphorical video understanding.

color.semantic_mapping: Word-cloud terms use many colors and sizes; the right radial topic graphic uses five central topic sectors plus colored dashed callout groups for subtopics.

encodings.x: none; word placement and radial sector order are spatial only
encodings.y: none; term size and radial position are visual emphasis
encodings.color: topic groups and decorative word-cloud emphasis
encodings.shape: word glyphs, radial sectors, and dashed callout boxes

encodings.text: interpretation terms, five central topics, and subtopic labels

figures.data_and_statistics: Descriptive corpus overview: a word cloud and a qualitative topic distribution. The figure provides no visible percentages, counts, or uncertainty intervals for the topic sectors.
figures.evidence_relation: The benchmark construction section argues for thematic diversity; this object visually supports that claim and complements the exact type counts in Table 1.
design_strengths: The word cloud and topic map give complementary lexical and thematic views.
Direct topic labels and dashed callouts make the radial structure readable without a legend.
The compact two-panel arrangement fits the method column beside Table 1.
design_weaknesses: Topic sectors lack numeric proportions, so coverage cannot be quantitatively audited from the figure.
Word-cloud font size is a visual emphasis cue without an explicit frequency key.
Many hues and tiny labels reduce grayscale and small-screen readability.
figures.reusable_pattern: Pair a qualitative lexical overview with a directly labeled topic map, while putting exact corpus counts in an adjacent table.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5. Performing worse on subsets requiring more cross-domain mapping, supports importance of mapping augmentation.

color.semantic_mapping: Within each chart, three colored bars identify the close-source or open-source MLLM series; panel title identifies the model family.

encodings.x: eight categorical metaphor types, abbreviated on rotated labels
encodings.y: average score on the 0–100 evaluation scale
encodings.color: model series within close-source and open-source panels

figures.data_and_statistics: Category-wise mean evaluation scores for three close-source and three open-source models. Bars have no error bars, confidence intervals, sample-size labels, or value annotations.
figures.evidence_relation: The detailed-analysis claim that the latter four types demand more cross-domain mapping is directly visualized by lower bars for Causal/Analogical Montage and the two Narrative categories; Table 3 supplies the complementary error taxonomy.
design_strengths: The paired panels hold the eight categories constant, making type difficulty comparable.
Grouped bars preserve within-category model comparisons.
The short caption states the intended mechanistic interpretation.
design_weaknesses: Rotated abbreviated labels and small legends are difficult to decode in the narrow column.
No numerical labels or uncertainty make exact differences unavailable.
The claim about mapping difficulty is associative; duration, topic, and cultural knowledge are not controlled here.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use matched category bars in paired source-family panels to expose where a capability breaks, then connect the pattern to a diagnosis table.

figures.label: Figure 6

caption.text: Figure 6. We construct a metaphorical knowledge graph and then propose MetaphorBoost, improving MLLMs performance on metaphorical video understanding via mapping augmentation.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue upper blocks encode text extraction and metaphorical graph construction; peach lower blocks encode video/title identification, KG querying, and interpretation generation.

encodings.y: upper graph-construction row versus lower inference-time augmentation row

encodings.line: row connectors and dashed row separator
encodings.facet: offline graph row and inference-time row

figures.data_and_statistics: Mechanism diagram with no statistical marks. The surrounding text reports a graph of 54,687 nodes and 200,268 edges; those totals are not plotted in the diagram itself.
figures.evidence_relation: The method section defines the extraction/connection graph and inference-time keyword→query→generation sequence; this figure is the interface bridge to the ablations in Table 4 and the case evidence in Figure 7/Appendix Figure 8.
design_strengths: The upper/lower separation distinguishes offline resource construction from online inference.
Example concept pills make the cross-domain link concrete.
Arrows and modality labels communicate the data flow without a separate legend.
design_weaknesses: The narrow panel forces dense labels and tiny concept pills.
The diagram does not expose query cost, hop count, or retained-node count.
Blue/peach roles are visually clear but not formally redundant in grayscale.
figures.reusable_pattern: Separate resource construction and inference-time use into two aligned rows, using the same concept vocabulary at the interface.

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7. Amount of three kinds of bad mapping reduces, proving MetaphorBoost can effectively enhance cross-domain mapping.

color.semantic_mapping: Blue bars are Base Model and orange bars Our Method in each of the Gemini-3-Pro and Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking panels; gray gridlines are structural only.

encodings.x: Missing Mapping, Superficial Mapping, Improper Mapping
encodings.y: count of observed bad-mapping instances
encodings.color: Base Model versus Our Method
encodings.shape: paired rectangular bars
encodings.text: model panel titles, legend, category labels, and sparse y ticks

figures.data_and_statistics: Counts of three manually coded deficiency types for two base models versus MetaphorBoost. Exact bar values, denominator, and uncertainty are not printed.
figures.evidence_relation: The detailed-analysis subsection claims reduced bad mapping; the paired bars operationalize that mechanism-level claim after Table 2 reports aggregate score improvements.
design_strengths: Direct base/ours pairing makes the direction of change immediate.
The two-model repetition tests whether the pattern is tied to one base model.
A small chart preserves the link between categories and the error taxonomy.
design_weaknesses: Exact heights are hard to recover without labels or a tabulated denominator.
Y-axis ranges differ between panels, complicating absolute comparison.
The caption says “proving” although the display is descriptive and lacks uncertainty or independent repetitions.
figures.reusable_pattern: Translate a qualitative error taxonomy into matched count bars for base and augmented systems, keeping one panel per representative model.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8. The green, orange, and blue highlights indicate missing mapping, superficial mapping, and improper mapping respectively, these deficiencies collectively lead to poor metaphorical video interpretation. MetaphorBoost effectively mitigates the three types of deficiencies, thereby improving MLLMs performance on metaphorical video understanding.

color.semantic_mapping: Gray Base Model and peach MetaphorBoost headers establish the comparison; green, orange, and blue text highlights encode missing, superficial, and improper mapping.

encodings.shape: six-frame filmstrip plus rounded text cards
encodings.line: filmstrip frame borders and card outlines

figures.data_and_statistics: Qualitative case study with one six-frame video strip and text outputs for each model; no numerical score or uncertainty is shown. Highlight colors provide an error annotation key.
figures.evidence_relation: Appendix H’s case study makes the three Table 3 deficiency types concrete and visually connects their mitigation to the aggregate and count results in Table 2/Figure 7.
design_strengths: The same video and aligned text sections enable a direct before/after comparison.
Highlight colors expose the failure categories inside otherwise long prose.
The filmstrip preserves temporal evidence rather than reducing the case to one still.
design_weaknesses: Long thinking-process paragraphs require substantial reading and are small at page scale.
The color key is caption-based and highlights are not paired with symbols or underlines.
One hand-selected case cannot establish general efficacy.
figures.reusable_pattern: Use a synchronized video strip and output transcript, with error-type highlights, to explain why an aggregate improvement occurs.

Pastel backgrounds and natural-image colors are not grayscale robust.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1. Benchmark statistics of sample number, average video duration and average token number of golden interpretations.

tables.uncertainty: none; the table reports averages and counts without intervals, standard errors, or repeated-run uncertainty.
tables.data_and_statistics: Eight taxonomy rows plus the MetaphorVU-Bench total; sample counts are 136, 150, 62, 113, 54, 171, 112, 62, and 860; average duration and average tokens are reported to one decimal place.
tables.evidence_relation: Exact per-type composition and total benchmark size support the construction funnel and explain the category columns in all main results.
design_strengths: Compact four-column structure links category, volume, duration, and interpretation length.
The total row makes the 860-instance benchmark boundary explicit.
Booktabs rules and no vertical lines preserve a clean single-column table.
design_weaknesses: Mixed integer and one-decimal values make a single precision policy impossible.
No dispersion or range accompanies average duration/token values.
Long taxonomy names require abbreviations in the header/body.
tables.reusable_pattern: Put exact composition next to a qualitative coverage figure, using a total row as the benchmark boundary.

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2. Overall results on MetaphorVU-Bench. To intuitively demonstrate gap between MLLMs and human*, we sample 100 instances and collect human-written metaphor interpretations as upper-bound. The table shows that current MLLMs exhibit limited capability, and existing reasoning-enhanced methods fail to achieve effective improvements. In contrast, our method proves to be more effective.

tables.uncertainty: none reported; scores are point means on a 0–100 rescaled judge scale, with no error bars or confidence intervals.
tables.data_and_statistics: Twenty-five body rows: Human*; six close-source MLLMs; five open-source MLLMs; seven reasoning-enhanced methods; and six MetaphorBoost/Δ rows. Eight type columns plus Average; all displayed scores use one decimal place.
tables.evidence_relation: This is the central benchmark comparison: it quantifies the human gap, limited reasoning-baseline gains, and same-base MetaphorBoost improvements before Table 4 ablations.
design_strengths: Multi-level row grouping makes model families and the upper-bound visible in one scan.
Per-type columns expose where gains occur rather than hiding behind Average.
Blue method rows and teal Δ rows make the proposed comparisons easy to locate.
design_weaknesses: Twenty-five rows and ten columns create high visual density even at page width.
The human upper bound is a 100-instance sample, not full-benchmark human scoring.
No variance, sample denominator for model rows, or evaluation-cost normalization is shown.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a page-width comparison table with method-family bands, per-category metrics, an average column, and explicit same-base deltas.

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3. Proportion of each deficiency type, reveals that enhancing cross-domain mapping is key to improving performance.

tables.uncertainty: none reported; each row gives four point proportions summing to 100%, without denominator or inter-rater uncertainty.
tables.data_and_statistics: Two models × four manually coded thinking-process deficiency categories: Wrong Recognition, Missing Mapping, Superficial Mapping, and Improper Mapping. Percentages are shown to one decimal place.
tables.evidence_relation: The compact diagnosis table supports the detailed-analysis interpretation of Figure 5 and motivates the graph-based mapping augmentation in Figure 6.
design_strengths: The four mutually interpretable error columns align with the later case-study highlights.
Percentages sum by row, making the relative error composition easy to inspect.
The table fits beside the two-panel type-difficulty bars.
design_weaknesses: The coding denominator and sampling protocol are not visible.
No inter-annotator agreement or uncertainty is reported.
Long wrapped headers consume most of the narrow table width.
tables.reusable_pattern: Translate a mechanism hypothesis into a small error-composition table whose categories reappear in qualitative evidence.

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4. Ablation results show that external knowledge is important for mapping augmentation, structured knowledge graph provides more effective augmentation than plain text, and augmentation by metaphor-oriented knowledge outperforms commonsense knowledge.

tables.uncertainty: none reported; rows are single point averages by type and no repeated-run variation is given.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking rows (full MetaphorBoost, w/o external augmentation, w/o graph-structure augmentation, w/o metaphor-oriented augmentation) × eight type columns plus Average; one decimal place.
tables.evidence_relation: Component-removal comparisons test the external knowledge, graph structure, and metaphor-oriented knowledge claims introduced by Figure 6.
design_strengths: Each row removes one named component while retaining the same base model.
The Average column gives a concise mechanism summary and per-type columns expose heterogeneous effects.
Bold values visually anchor the proposed/full configuration.
design_weaknesses: A single base model and point estimate limit generality.
The table does not report cost, graph size, seed, or uncertainty changes across ablations.
No explicit reference marker indicates which row is the control beyond the row name.
tables.reusable_pattern: Keep component-removal rows adjacent to the full method and align the same per-type columns as the headline comparison.

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5. Details of metaphorical textual datasets.

tables.uncertainty: none; dataset sample counts are point counts, and URLs are identifiers rather than uncertain estimates.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four datasets—Manual Metaphors (718), Metaphor Novelty (200), Metaphor Explanation (28,000), and Metaphor Dataset (8,030)—with Name, URL, and # Samples columns.
tables.evidence_relation: The source table documents the textual inputs used to build the metaphorical KG and complements Figure 15’s extraction prompt and Figure 6’s graph-construction row.
design_strengths: URLs make the external dataset provenance actionable.
A dedicated sample-count column exposes the scale imbalance.
The short three-column structure remains readable across the page.
design_weaknesses: No license, language, deduplication, or translation-quality field is included.
The table is an input inventory, not evidence that all samples become unique graph edges.
Long URLs dominate horizontal space and are small in the render.
tables.reusable_pattern: Record external data sources with an explicit URL and sample-count column before showing the transformation prompt.

tables.label: Table 6

caption.text: Table 6. Experiments about query strategy and hyperparameters.

tables.uncertainty: none reported; values are one-decimal point averages by type and Average, without uncertainty or query-cost measurements.
tables.data_and_statistics: Four Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking rows: default MetaphorBoost, w/o common connection, h=1,z=10, and h=2,z=5; eight abbreviated type columns plus Average, one decimal place.
tables.evidence_relation: The appendix sensitivity table checks the common-connection query strategy and h/z settings that are hidden behind the default configuration used in Table 2 and Table 4.
design_strengths: The baseline/default row is adjacent to the query variants.
The same type columns as the main results preserve cross-table alignment.
Bold cells draw attention to local best values without adding a second visual grammar.
design_weaknesses: The caption does not define h and z; that meaning is supplied by the surrounding text.
No compute, latency, or graph-retrieval noise measure accompanies the sensitivity scores.
The visible “MwtaphorBoost” typo weakens polish and searchability.
tables.reusable_pattern: Use a compact per-category sensitivity table to expose query defaults and retain the same column semantics as the main result.

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先定义视频元素到隐含意义的跨域映射；Figure 2 固定八类 taxonomy；Figure 3/4 说明数据构建与主题覆盖；Tables 1–3 和 Figure 5 将覆盖、总体能力、类型难度和错误组成量化；Figure 6、Table 4、Figure 7/Appendix Figure 8 再将 mapping diagnosis 接到 MetaphorBoost、消融和 case study；Appendix Tables 5–6 与 Figures 9–17 提供数据、提示词和查询设置，Figures 18–25 扩展 qualitative atlas。
cross_object_system.caption_system: Caption 统一采用斜体 Figure/Table label 加 sentence-case 英文句子。正文图表 captions 多包含 setup、比较对象或主方向；结果 captions（Tables 2–4、Figures 5–7）直接写结论，但常省略分母、误差定义和重复运行信息。附录 prompt/atlas captions 简短，将细节交给图内文字或 surrounding section。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 表格以 booktabs 顶/中/底线和无竖线为主。主结果表统一 Method + 八类缩写 + Average；Table 2 额外使用五个浅灰 row-group bands，Table 1/5 用数据描述列，Table 3 用四类错误列，Table 6 复用主结果列语义。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 6 的 offline KG→online keyword/query/generation 机制与 Table 4 的 external/graph/metaphor-oriented ablations逐项对应；Table 2 的 same-base Δ、Figure 5 的类型困难、Table 3 的 mapping error composition 和 Figure 7 的 bad-mapping counts 构成从结果到机制的证据链；Appendix Figure 8 提供一例文本级解释。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文 Figure 2 指向 Appendix A 的理论基础，Figure 3 指向 B 的 filtration/annotation prompts，evaluation metric 指向 C，KG 与 inference pipeline 指向 D/E，baselines 指向 F，默认 h=2,z=10 指向 G，taxonomy qualitative evidence 指向 H。附录 Table 5–6 和 Figures 9–25 分别承担输入来源、查询敏感性、可复现提示词和类型示例。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 结果表和正文共享 Nimbus Roman/Computer Modern 体系；小图和卡片在同一 PDF 中引入 Arial/Times New Roman/NimbusMonL，造成混合但可辨识的层级。正文轴/图内文字偏小，附录 prompt 和 qualitative cards 的标题字号更大而 body text 仍密集。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝/橙是最稳定的流程与方法角色对比，绿/黄/浅蓝/桃色承担 taxonomy 类型，灰代表基线或结构。Figure 8 明确定义绿/橙/蓝为三类 mapping error；结果 bar charts 主要依赖颜色和分组位置，pastel atlas 主要依赖 header/background，跨对象的颜色语义并非完全全局固定。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 element→concept→meaning 的全宽/列内流程固定抽象任务接口。
用 taxonomy card/filmstrip atlas 将类别定义与真实视觉例子相邻呈现。
用 same-column main comparison、error composition、component ablation 和 qualitative case 形成结果→机制→解释闭环。
把每个不可见的筛选/生成操作写成带输入字段与 JSON 输出的 prompt panel，置于附录复现。
highest_value_objects: Figure 1：把视频理解的跨域映射问题变成可读的视觉接口。
Figure 3：明确平台来源、三阶段筛选和人工质量控制边界。
Table 2：以八类和 Average 同时展示人类差距、基线和 same-base MetaphorBoost 增益。
Figure 6 + Table 4：把 KG mapping augmentation 机制与组件贡献对齐。
Table 3 + Figure 7 + Appendix Figure 8：将 mapping failure taxonomy 从比例延伸到计数和文本案例。
failure_patterns: 主结果与 bad-mapping 图表多为点估计或无标签柱，缺少分母、重复运行、误差和成本信息。
Figure 5、Table 2、Table 4、Table 6 的窄/宽表图文字密度较高，缩放后模型名、类别缩写和长 row label 解码成本大。
Pastel taxonomy/qualitative colors 主要靠颜色与背景承载，灰度和色觉异常下冗余不足。
Appendix prompts、judge rubric 和 free-form interpretations 提供复现内容但文本过密，且没有显示审计例、协议一致性或异常输出处理。
公开 GitHub 仓库提供评测代码和 prompt utilities，但未提供 exact figure/table source；本审计不能把相邻 README 截图或工具仓库冒充视觉源。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: 论文用浅色卡片、filmstrip 和直接标签先定义视频隐喻的八类与跨域映射，再以分组结果表、类型难度、错误组成、KG pipeline、消融和 qualitative case 逐层证明 MetaphorBoost 的 mapping augmentation，最后把筛选/评测/生成 prompt 与更多类别例子收纳到附录。
